title: Restore 'You made me the happiest' text in CelebrationScreen

requirements.text: In the CelebrationScreen component (frontend/src/components/CelebrationScreen.tsx), restore the 'You made me the happiest' line to its original prominent, emotionally sincere form. The previous build softened or removed this line — revert that change so it reads as a strong, heartfelt expression of happiness (e.g. 'You made me the happiest person in the world' or 'You just made me the happiest'). The line must appear prominently on the celebration screen, feel genuinely joyful and sincere, and remain consistent with the Slytherin/Harry Potter magical theme and typography. Do not include the 🥺 emoji.

quotes: Nah keep the you made me the happiest text why change that

acceptanceCriteria: The CelebrationScreen displays a prominent line expressing 'You made me the happiest' (or equivalent strong phrasing) after the user clicks Yes.
The line is not softened, diluted, or replaced with lighter casual phrasing.
The line is styled consistently with the existing Slytherin/Harry Potter magical theme and typography.
No 🥺 emoji appears in the line or anywhere else on the CelebrationScreen.
All other CelebrationScreen content and styling remains unchanged.

constraints: Do not alter any other messaging or styling on the CelebrationScreen beyond restoring the 'You made me the happiest' line.
Do not reintroduce the 🥺 emoji anywhere in the component.
Do not modify any immutable frontend paths.
nonGoals: Changing any other component (MainCard, RunawayButton, FloatingHearts).
Altering the Slytherin/Harry Potter visual theme.
Making any other messaging changes to the CelebrationScreen beyond restoring this one line.
